questions.solution_text:
The radials $OB$ and $OC$ lie either side of north, so add the two parts.
$\angle BOC=(360^{\circ}-327^{\circ})+58^{\circ}$
$=91^{\circ}$
$A=\tfrac{1}{2}(46)(53)\sin 91^{\circ}$
$=1218.8143\ldots$
$\approx 1218.8\text{ m}^{2}$

questions.solution_text:
The radials $OV$ and $OW$ lie either side of north, so add the two parts.
$\angle VOW=(360^{\circ}-292^{\circ})+41^{\circ}$
$=109^{\circ}$
$VW=\sqrt{37^{2}+44^{2}-2(37)(44)\cos 109^{\circ}}$
$=\sqrt{4365.0454\ldots}$
$=66.0685\ldots$
$\approx 66.1\text{ m}$
